remarks:
Rare 102.3-acre corner parcel at Beebe Rd and Nelson Rd in the Town of Wilson (Newfane mailing address) within the Wilson Central School District. Dual road frontage on both Beebe Rd and Nelson Rd with approx. 1,337 ft of frontage and 2,740 ft of depth. The land is level and largely clear, with partially wooded areas and scenic views. Assessed as an air-transport (airport) property, it is a one-of-a-kind opportunity for aviation enthusiasts, as well as for agricultural, equestrian, hunting and recreational use or future residential development. Improvements include two wood barns offering storage and utility space; one barn needs significant repair. Public water is available and electric is on site. Existing septic. Whether you are looking to invest, farm, hunt, build or develop, acreage like this in a prime location rarely comes to market. Sold as-is. Please note: the house fronting Beebe Rd is a neighboring property and is not part of the sale.

Please note:  Do not walk the land without an appointment. Septic cannot be tested. Barns will not be broom-swept at closing; items are being removed. The former house was torn down years ago; public-record SF/year built refer to that house. The house fronting Beebe Rd is a neighbor's and is NOT part of the sale. Property is classified 844 - Air Transport; buyer to verify zoning and any FAA status with the Town of Wilson/FAA.
